title: Newhalo page hero
description: The black band that opens an inner page: a 100px amber-to-red title whose gradient sweeps in from the left on load, with one of three companions: a 28px question and an underlined arrow link on the right, a row of numbered square steps joined by a dotted line, or a large rounded photo on the right half (full-width on top on phones) that drifts as you scroll.
notes: always dark (wraps itself in .dark); leaves room at the top for newhalo-header
the aside is desktop-only, as in the original (phones show the same prompt further down the page)
name: newhalo-page-hero

props.name: detail
props.description: a 32px line under the title (an email address, a short claim)

props.name: aside
props.type: { title?: string; link: { label: string; href: string; }; }
props.description: a question and an underlined arrow link on the right (desktop)

props.name: steps
props.description: numbered steps in a row, joined by a dotted line (a column on phones)

props.name: withMedia
props.description: show a photo slot on the right half (on top on phones)

props.name: media
props.description: the photo for that slot; empty shows the placeholder
